blocks.text: PET scanning machine ka schematic diagram (saada khaaka) Fig. 20.11 mein hai. PET scan mein radioactive tracer ki thora sa amount (miqdar) vein (nas) mein inject ki jati hai. Blood (khoon) tracer ko le jata hai aur yeh zyada active (sargarm) tissues mein zyada jama hota hai, jaise bohat se cancers ya brain aur dil ke kaam karte hisse. Tracer ke unstable nuclei decay (toot) hote hue positrons chhorte hain. Har positron thora sa faasla tay kar ke qareeb ke tissue ke electron se milta hai. Milne par positron aur electron annihilate hote hain aur un ka mass energy ban kar do gamma-ray photons ki shakal mein opposite directions mein nikalta hai. Mareez ke gird ring mein lage detectors in photon pairs (joron) ko detect kar ke signals computer ko bhejte hain, jo saaf images banata hai ke tracer kahan jama hua. PET image ke zyada bright (roshan) hisse zyada tracer concentration, yani zyada tissue activity, dikhate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: positron emitter, ek atom jis ka nucleus electrons ke darmiyan positron chhorta hai; positron electron se mil kar annihilate (khatam) hota hai aur do gamma-rays opposite directions mein bhejta hai. Darmiyan: PET scanner ki ring, couch par mareez aur mareez se ring tak gamma-rays. Ek mura hua arrow, jis ke paas kitab ki tarah positron-electron annihilation likha hai, daen taraf computer display tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.11: PET scanning ka schematic diagram (kitab ki Figure 20.11 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tracer ka nucleus positron chhorta hai; positron qareeb ke electron se mil kar khatam hota hai aur 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays opposite directions mein nikalti hain. Scanner ki ring dono ko ek saath detect karti hai aur computer image banata hai.
